newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against European currencies, but closed firmer on the U.S. dollar and the rand, exchange dealers said on Tuesday.
"The dollar firmed a bit on export receipts. We saw two banks selling in the market in the morning but I'm not quite sure where the money was coming from," commented one dealer.
He said the Zimbabwe dollar finished the day at 10.8550/8700 against the U.S. dollar compared to 10.8675/8825 overnight and edged up to 2.3100/3162 from 2.3300/3500 versus South Africa's rand.

On the crosses, it lost ground to 18.3830/4195 from 18.0700/0900 against sterling, tracking a weaker U.S. dollar overseas, and was at 6.9655/9775 against the mark, down from 6.6800/7000 the previous day.
